text:
```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  pr-closer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go for gh CLI
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Authenticate with GitHub
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token -

      - name: Get list of open PRs
        id: get_prs
        run: |
          gh pr list --state open --json number,title,author.login,labels.name --limit 1000 > prs.json

      - name: Process PRs
        run: |
          jq '.[] | select(.author.login != "jdx" and (.labels.name | index("keep-open") == null)) | {number: .number, title: .title}' < prs.json > filtered_prs.json

      - name: Close PRs
        run: |
          while read -r line; do
            pr_number=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.number')
            pr_title=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.title')
            echo "Closing PR #${pr_number}: ${pr_title}"
            gh pr close --number $pr_number --comment "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you believe this PR should not have been closed, please reopen it."
          done < filtered_prs.json
```
